description: IPO calendar. Retrieve IPO calendar data for a specified time range → Returns {total_count: number, range: string, last_update: number, data: [{code: string, name: string, country: string, currency: string, status: string, offer_time: number, offer_price: number, offered_shares: number, deal_amount: number, price_range: string, market_cap: number}]}. Default: current week. Use 'w' to look ahead or 'month' for one historical UTC month; w takes precedence. Filter by country with 'c' or symbol with 'code' (e.g., 'NASDAQ:AAPL'). HTTP 200 may return error=no_data and a message when the requested period has no data.

c.description: (Optional) Filter by country code(s) as a comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 string, for example `US,AR`. Invalid codes will be ignored.

code.description: (Optional) Filter by symbol code in Exchange:Symbol format (e.g., NASDAQ:AAPL). Returns only calendar entries matching this symbol.

filter.description: (Optional) JSONata expression to return only the fields or rows you need. See https://jsonata.org for syntax.

month.description: Fetches one historical UTC calendar month in YYYY-MM format when w is absent. Invalid months are rejected even when w is provided. The current or a future month is rejected. Oldest available months are 2012-12 for events, 2025-01 for dividends, 2012-04 for earnings, and 1995-01 for IPOs.

output_dir.description: Directory for stored response when output_file is not set.

store.description: Store the response locally instead of returning it. Default is none. csv is only supported for get_symbol_series.

w.description: Specifies the week range. For example, 1 means this week (starting today) through next week, 2 means next week through the following week, and so on. When provided, this parameter takes precedence over month.

name: get_ipos
